```{r setup}
library(hlebuhanec.0325)
library(sva)
library(limma)
```

```{r}
data("rna_raw")
data("metadata_rna")
metadata_rna <- metadata_rna %>%
    mutate(across(c(Batch, Group, Sex), as.factor))

rna_processed <- rna_raw %>%
    mutate(ID = str_remove(ID, "\\.\\d+$")) %>%
    column_to_rownames("ID") %>%
    select(any_of(pull(metadata_rna, "Patient"))) %>%
   .[rowSums(. >= 10) >= 3, ]

covar_mod <- model.matrix(~ Age + Sex, data = metadata_rna)

counts_adj0 <- ComBat_seq(
  counts    = as.matrix(rna_processed),
  batch     = metadata_rna$Batch,
  group     = NULL,
  covar_mod = covar_mod
)

couts_norm <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_adj0, colData = metadata_rna, design = ~1) %>%
  estimateSizeFactors() %>%
  vst(blind = TRUE) %>%
  assay()

couts_norm2 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = rna_processed, colData = metadata_rna, design = ~1) %>%
  estimateSizeFactors() %>%
  vst(blind = TRUE) %>%
  assay()

counts_adj <- removeBatchEffect(
  couts_norm,
  batch      = metadata_rna$Sex,
  covariates = metadata_rna$Age
)
```

```{r}
plot_pca <- function(m, title) {
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), scale. = FALSE)
  df <- data.frame(pc$x[, 1:2], batch = metadata_rna$Batch,
                   age = metadata_rna$Age, sex = metadata_rna$Sex)
  ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = batch, size = age, shape = sex)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_pca0 <- function(m, var = "Sex") {
  pca <- prcomp(t(m), scale. = FALSE)
  pca_data <- pluck(pca, "x") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Patient") %>%
    left_join(metadata_rna, by = "Patient")
  
  percentVar <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  
  centroids <- pca_data %>%
    group_by(!!sym(var)) %>%
    summarise(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2))

ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = !!sym(var))) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = !!sym(var), color = !!sym(var))) +
  geom_point(
    data = centroids,
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = !!sym(var)),
    shape = 4, size = 5, stroke = 1.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1: ", round(percentVar[1] * 100, 1), "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", round(percentVar[2] * 100, 1), "% variance")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_custom() +
  scale_color_discrete(type = palette_discrete())
}
 
plot_pca0(couts_norm2)
plot_pca0(counts_adj)
```
